title: refactor(plugin-grid): move ObjectGrid's column generator, column post-processing and Actions column into sibling modules (slice 8)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8KF8i7bmUmRJW1rodBW4KnP)_

Fixes #25994 (slice 8, the last slice of the move-only split: regions R, U and V. Slices 1 to 7 have landed; this one closes the card.)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:把 `ObjectGrid.tsx` 里最后三大块代码(列生成回调 `generateColumns`、列后处理与持久化列宽列序、操作列与固定列集合)原样搬进三个同目录模块,组件在原位置调用它们;文件从 5160 行降到 3962 行(拆分前 7689 行)。
- 为什么改:维护者裁决「大文件互踩： 立重构卡把 ObjectView 和 ObjectGrid 拆成小模块。这个可以立卡」;这是第 8 片也是最后一片,合并后关闭 #25994。
- 风险与回滚:纯搬移,无逻辑、命名、渲染变化,hook 调用顺序不变;五个读源码的测试只改了读取路径。有问题直接 revert 本 PR 即可。
- 先看:`objectGridGenerateColumns.tsx` 的签名与依赖数组(与原 `useCallback` 相同)、`ObjectGrid.tsx` 里三处调用、五个测试文件的路径改动。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/ --maxWorkers=2`,预期 253 个文件、2256 个测试全绿,与 main 相同。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地;合并即关闭 #25994。

## What changes

Base `7bdff7ec` (`origin/main`). `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` is 5160 lines there. This slice moves regions **R**, **U** and **V** of the seam table in #26364 (re-planned in #26499), the last three blocks the card names, verbatim into three new sibling modules:

| # | Concern | New home | Inputs | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| R | `generateColumns`, the `useCallback` that turns the authored columns, or the object's fields, into column drafts (base lines 1221 to 2098) | hook `useObjectGridGenerateColumns` in `objectGridGenerateColumns.tsx` | 18: `schema`, `dataSource`, `data`, `dataConfig`, `hasInlineData`, `objectName`, `objectSchema`, `objectFields`, `objectTypesPending`, `schemaFields`, `schemaColumns`, `perms`, `navigation`, `executeAction`, `predicateScope`, `resolveFieldLabel`, `translateOptions`, `uiLanguage` | `generateColumns` |
| U | Column post-processing: field-type enrichment, the fold onto the declared column type, the user's persisted widths and order (base lines 2377 to 2557) | function `resolveObjectGridPersistedColumns` in `objectGridPersistedColumns.ts` | `generateColumns`, `objectFields`, `objectName`, `perms`, `objectTypesPending`, `columnState` | `persistedColumns` |
| V | The Actions column, its NON-AUTHOR SURFACE comment on `maxInlineRowActions`, and the pinned column sets (base lines 2559 to 2719) | function `resolveObjectGridActionsColumn` in `objectGridActionsColumn.tsx` | 22, from `schema` to `t` (listed in the module signature) | `columnsWithActions`, `hasActions`, `hasPinnedColumns`, `hasUserPinnedColumns`, `pinnedLeftCols`, `pinnedRightCols`, `unpinnedCols`, `rightPinnedClasses`, `rightPinnedCellClasses`, `userLeftPinnedCount` |

- R is a hook and keeps its `useCallback` with the same dependency array, called where the callback stood, so the component's hook order does not change. U and V stand below the component's early returns, so they are plain functions, as on slices 5 to 7.
- Inputs are typed from their source: `ReturnType` of the hook or helper that produces them (`usePermissions`, `useNavigationOverlay`, `useAction`, `usePredicateScope`, `useSafeFieldLabel`, `useGridTranslation`, `useObjectGridQueryInputs`, `useObjectGridColumnState`, `useCapabilityGate`, `useRecordCrudVerdicts`, `resolveLegacyRowActions`, `resolveRowCrudAffordances`), `ObjectGridComponentProps` for the host callbacks, and React's `Dispatch` of `SetStateAction` for `setRefreshKey`. No context.
- Each module returns only the names the rest of the component reads.
- Imports: the specifiers whose only readers moved leave `ObjectGrid.tsx` and appear in the module that reads them; two whole imports (`applyRelationalMeta`, `resolvesToDataColumn`) move. The `export` and `export type` re-exports at the top of `ObjectGrid.tsx` are untouched, so the package entry and every exported name are unchanged.
- `ObjectGrid.tsx` goes from 5160 to 3962 lines. The diff is 2674 changed lines in 10 files.

**Move-only proof.** The multiset of non-blank lines of the base `ObjectGrid.tsx` equals the new `ObjectGrid.tsx` plus the three modules, except for 10 lines, all of them edited import lines in `ObjectGrid.tsx` that lost specifiers. Every added line is a module header or docblock, an import, a signature or parameter type, a `return { … }` list, or in `ObjectGrid.tsx` one of the three new imports and three calls with their comments.

**The split, slices 1 to 8.** Line counts of `ObjectGrid.tsx` on `main` after each merge:

| Slice | PR | Moved | New sibling modules | Lines after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| (start) | | | | 7689 |
| 1 | #26323 | module-level helpers, types and constants | `objectGridColumns.ts`, `objectGridDefaults.ts`, `objectGridLinkCell.tsx`, `objectGridQuery.ts`, `objectGridRowVersion.ts`, `objectGridTranslations.ts` | 6781 |
| 2 | #26354 | host-facing props types and `FooterSummaryReport` | `objectGridProps.ts` | 6637 |
| 3 | #26364 | authored-input diagnostics (seam table) | `objectGridDiagnostics.ts` | 6571 |
| 4 | #26499 | query inputs and grouping decisions (re-plan) | `objectGridQueryInputs.ts`, `objectGridGroupingDecisions.ts` | 6307 |
| 5 | #26537 | row load | `objectGridRowLoad.ts` | 5639 |
| 6 | #26574 | grouping and column summaries | `objectGridGrouping.ts`, `objectGridSummaries.ts` | 5250 |
| 7 | #26773 | row-height sync, column state, mobile affordances | `objectGridRowHeight.ts`, `objectGridColumnState.ts`, `objectGridMobile.ts` | 5160 |
| 8 | this PR | column generator, column post-processing, Actions column | `objectGridGenerateColumns.tsx`, `objectGridPersistedColumns.ts`, `objectGridActionsColumn.tsx` | **3962** |

Final count: `ObjectGrid.tsx` is 3962 lines, down from 7689 (48% smaller), with 19 sibling modules beside it. What remains is the component itself (state, the remaining handlers, the render) and the re-exports.

**Open PRs on these files.** Of the 26 open PRs, one touches `ObjectGrid.tsx`: #26804 (opened after this slice's claim), with hunks at the components import, the `useOverlayAnchor` call and the record-overlay props, none of them inside R, U or V. `git merge-tree` of this head with #26804's head merges with no conflict. No open PR touches the five test files or the three new modules.

## Why

The card's ruling, verbatim: 「大文件互踩： 立重构卡把 ObjectView 和 ObjectGrid 拆成小模块。这个可以立卡」. One move-only slice per PR, per the card's ask 1 to 5; this is the last slice named in hand-off 6438136564 and dispatch order 6446731987, so the PR closes the card.

## Tests

Five test edits, path-only, forced by the move. Each joins the moved file to the source it already read; no assertion, pattern or count changed.

- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/columnReadBoundary-6458.test.ts`: `gridSource` reads `objectGridGenerateColumns.tsx` and `ObjectGrid.tsx` joined, in that order. The `ListColumn` branch of `generateColumns()` that the scan bounds moved with R, and the order keeps the `(schema as any).hideRowHeightToggle` control after the region end.
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/cellRendererResolutionBoundary-8920.test.ts`: the "ObjectGrid.tsx makes no direct resolver call" case reads `ObjectGrid.tsx` and `objectGridGenerateColumns.tsx` joined, because the call sites it guards moved with R.
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/relationalMetaCopySet.derivation.test.ts`: the LIT CONTROL's `wholeFile` reads both files joined, because most `fieldMeta` reads moved with R. The `    renderCellEditor:` seam stays in `ObjectGrid.tsx`, so the zero it asserts is unchanged.
- `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/gridNonAuthorKeys.test.tsx`: the control case also reads `objectGridActionsColumn.tsx`, because the NON-AUTHOR SURFACE comment on `maxInlineRowActions` moved with V.
- `ui/packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/column-identity.ratchet.test.ts`: the CONVERGED entry follows `columnIdentity(` from `plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` to `plugin-grid/src/objectGridGenerateColumns.tsx`.

`percent-storage-callers-11475` needs no edit: `formatPercent` stays in the mobile card in `ObjectGrid.tsx`, and none of the moved lines call it. I matched every string literal of every tracked test and script against the lines that left `ObjectGrid.tsx`; the other hits were generic words or behavioural tests, and all of them ran green below.

## Acceptance notes

- Some parameter types are `any`, copied from the component's own declarations: `data` is an any-typed array and `objectSchema` is `any` in the component's `useState` calls, and `objectFields` is declared in the component as a record of `any` or undefined. The new parameters spell those same types, which is the 6 new `no-explicit-any` warnings. Narrowing them would go beyond a move.
- eslint on the four files: 0 errors; warnings 179 before, 185 after (the 6 above). Unlike the earlier hook slices, no React lint finding is hidden this time: the `exhaustive-deps` finding on `generateColumns` (missing `navigation` and `schema.showColumnTypeIcons`) is raised in the new module exactly as before, and the other findings are the same at shifted lines.
- R's module is `.tsx` and V's is `.tsx` because they hold JSX; U's is `.ts`. The claim said `objectGrid*.ts`.
- Moved comments that point "below" or "above" are kept verbatim. Most remain true inside the module; `renderCellEditor` "(below)" in `objectGridPersistedColumns.ts` now lives in `ObjectGrid.tsx`.
- `objectGridActionsColumn.tsx` imports `ObjectGridComponentProps` from `./ObjectGrid` as a type only, so no runtime cycle is added.

## Verification

Run on head `ab6ff716`:

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/ --maxWorkers=2` under the verification lock: 253 of 253 files, 2256 of 2256 tests after the move. Before: the same command on base `7bdff7ec` (a separate worktree, deps built): 253 of 253 files, 2256 of 2256 tests.
- The 109 test files outside plugin-grid that read source trees (every ui test that reads files and names plugin-grid or walks the package roots, including `column-identity.ratchet`, `percent-storage-callers-11475`, `affordanceGrantMap-12082`, `catalog-gallery-render` and `registry-inputs-spec-parity`): 109 of 109 files, 3413 of 3413 tests.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check` exit 0, after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-grid^...'`.
- The Type Check UI job's 17 `check:*` steps plus `type-check:coverage`: all exit 0 (`check:spec-symbols` and `check:doc-example-readers` included; no new local type shares a spec name, and no single-return wrapper is exported). `pnpm check:changeset-fixed` exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations` (report-only, exit 0) reports 1 new citation: `apps/console/src/dev/DevRowActions.tsx:51` in `objectGridActionsColumn.tsx`. It is not new prose; the comment moved verbatim with V, and the gate counts it because it changed files. It is kept as it was, since rewording it would not be move-only.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 35 derived commands, all exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` under the lock: 178 passed and 2 skipped files, 5065 passed and 2 skipped tests. Its first run hit a 15-second timeout in one `check-i18n-dead-keys` real-tree case while the gate list ran beside it; the rerun alone was green. `--ran` reconciles 35 of 35 (0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN); the Type Check UI commands above are recorded as outside the derivation.

Changeset: `.changeset/25994-objectgrid-columns-modules.md` (patch, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; eslint on the touched files reports 0 errors.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the maintainer quick-read section and the quoted ruling are Chinese by rule).
